messages.text: ok, that worked.. clunkyas af.  qs has to actually give focus to ur tab for you to speak so it flashes to ur browser tab while u speak and then goes back to qs

messages.speaker: 🔮 Grok
messages.text:
Yeah, that’s the clunky part.
Because this UI won’t start the audio until the tab has focus, QS has to yank focus over here, wait for the speak to finish, then yank it back. The flash is unavoidable with the current Grok behavior.
It works, just not elegant. Luma will have the data now. Ready for whatever’s next.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text: fyi.. QS is going to soon have new name.  google always try to turn 'quacksink' into navy's 'quicksink' or 'quacksync' etc etc..  so I did some thunks and decided to come up with a catchy easy to remember .. easy to say.. easy to spell name.. and came up with.... you ready?

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text: Purple Python Relay System PPRS or just Purple Python

messages.speaker: 🔮 Grok
messages.text:
Purple Python.
PPRS.
That is clean, easy to say, easy to spell, and doesn’t get auto-mangled into Navy ordinance or some random sync tool.
I like it. The snake gets its own color and the relay stays in the name.
Solid rebrand.
